map.字母重排组合数 = 字母数 n 的阶乘 ÷（各重复字母出现次数阶乘之积）；从字母: The tool does not enumerate permutations: it filters the built-in common word list for words spellable from the given letters (each letter up to its given multiplicity, length >=3). Scoring is the sum of matched word lengths; the round ends when every valid word in the list is found.

map.单词训练：给定一组英文字母，从内置常用词库中找出能拼出的 ≥3 字母英文单词，练: Vocabulary training: from a set of English letters, find the >=3-letter English words spellable from the built-in common word list to practice vocabulary and spelling.
map.英语教学：按长度或字典序排列结果，用于课堂单词拓展与拼写竞赛。: English teaching: sort results by length or alphabetical order for classroom vocabulary expansion and spelling contests.
map.脑力锻炼：限定时间内尽可能多拼词，记录命中数与最长词。: Brain exercise: within a time limit, spell as many words as possible and record the hit count and longest word.
map.输入或随机给一组字母（如 6 个），工具按字典穷举所有「字母不重复使用」且长度: The tool ships 5 fixed letter sets (LISTEN, TRIANGLE, PAINTER, TEACHER, GARDEN) and a built-in common word list (hundreds of 3-8 letter words). Each round picks one set and filters the word list for words spellable with each letter used at most its given multiplicity; submissions must pass both the letter check and the word-list check. It does not enumerate all English words, so rare or unlisted words are not counted.
map.字母组 LISTEN 可重排出 SILENT、TINSEL、ENLIST、INL: The letter set LISTEN yields built-in words such as LISTEN, SILENT, ENLIST, TINSEL, INLETS, LINES, TILES, LINE, TILE, SITE, LIST, LINT, NEST, SENT, TIE and SIN. Words not in the list or not spellable from the letters (SLIME, EMITS, ISLET) are not counted. The number of valid words depends on the letter set and the word-list coverage, usually a dozen to a few dozen.
map.默认每个给定字母在同一单词里至多使用一次（对应原词字母多重数）；若原词含重复字母: By default each given letter is used at most once per word (matching the letter multiplicity of the source); if the source has repeated letters, reuse within that multiplicity is allowed.
map.720 种排列里绝大多数是乱序非词，只有通过词表校验的才列出，故有效词通常十几个: The page does not enumerate permutations; it filters the built-in word list directly, so valid words usually number a dozen to a few dozen. The list covers common words only, so rarer words may be missed because of limited coverage rather than a calculation error.
